q: We investigated how demographic characteristics inferred by AI coding assistants can influence AI-assisted software development through a two-phase mixed-methods study.
r: IC1: demographic bias in ChatGPT-generated websites, not an evaluation or comparison of coding agents or SDD or context files.

q: LiveEvalBench models it as a collaborative expert review workflow that is agentic, adaptive, and extensible
r: IC1: the agentic part is the evaluator; the evaluated models do one-shot web generation, not coding agents.

q: Each model generates one application per requirement through an agentic coding framework, yielding 17 × 369 = 6,273 applications and reflecting practical workflows for web application generation.
r: Include: benchmark of 369 real-world requirements for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) building web applications, with a new evaluation pipeline.

q: we query each model through its vendor’s official API under a unified generation protocol.
r: IC1: VLMs are queried via API for one-shot screenshot-to-app generation, with no coding agent.

q: without runtime feedback, semantic repair, or agentic coding workflows.
r: IC1: LLMs generate games in one pass from specifications; the paper states it excludes agentic coding workflows.

q: as coding agents on RefCraft. All models are evaluated using the same OpenCode v1.
r: Include: benchmark evaluating nine models as coding agents in a common OpenCode harness building webpages from queries, with a new keypoint-based evaluation protocol.

q: users now build entire products without writing code, through successive feature requests to an agent.
r: Include: long-horizon benchmark of agents building a whole product from successive feature requests, with cost and pass@1 metrics.

q: a fully automated pipeline carries an agent from planning through implementation, build, and autonomous playtest to a self-contained browser game.
r: Include: from-scratch long-horizon agent benchmark with functional, playtest and human-preference evaluation; project-level, new evaluation design.
